evals.name: year-2026
evals.expected_output: outputs/releases/2026-impact-summary.md exists with three sections (measured-impact table, themes, coverage gap), no chronological table, no method appendix. The measured-impact table contains the 5 releases with comments authored by Giovanni Mautino or Ivan Parenti (MOL-432, MOL-429, MOL-437, MOL-455, MOL-484). Frontmatter includes window, release_count, impact_count.

evals.name: q1-2026
evals.prompt: what shipped in Q1 2026? pull from MOL release notes
evals.expected_output: outputs/releases/2026-q1-impact-summary.md exists with the same three-section structure, scoped to releases dated 2026-01-01..2026-03-31. Measured-impact table includes MOL-429, MOL-432, MOL-437, MOL-455 (not MOL-484, which is April). Excludes any release dated 2026-04 or later.

evals.name: last-30-days
evals.prompt: summarize releases from the last 30 days
evals.expected_output: outputs/releases/<TODAY>-last-30-days-impact-summary.md (where <TODAY> is the YYYY-MM-DD of when the run started) exists. Window is computed relative to today's date. Includes recent April 2026 releases (MOL-484, MOL-486, MOL-487, MOL-505, MOL-506, MOL-508, MOL-509, MOL-510, MOL-511, MOL-512, MOL-514, etc.). MOL-484 appears in the measured-impact table.
